name: AppFlowy-Nginx
description: Step 7/7 (deploy last): Nginx reverse proxy — the single entry point for all AppFlowy Cloud services. Routes HTTP/WebSocket traffic to AppFlowy-Cloud, AppFlowy-GoTrue, AppFlowy-Web, AppFlowy-Admin, and AppFlowy-MinIO. Part of the AppFlowy Cloud stack.

paths.name: nginx.conf
paths.description: nginx configuration file. Use nginx.conf (HTTP only), nginx-https-custom.conf (user-provided TLS certs), or nginx-letsencrypt.conf (Let's Encrypt). All configs are in the template repository.

paths.name: SSL Directory
paths.description: Directory for user-provided TLS certificate and key (certificate.crt, private_key.key). Required for nginx-https-custom.conf. Create the directory even if empty.

paths.name: Let's Encrypt certs (optional)
paths.description: Directory where AppFlowy-Certbot stores Let's Encrypt certificates. Required only when using nginx-letsencrypt.conf.

paths.name: Certbot webroot (optional)
paths.description: Webroot directory for Let's Encrypt HTTP-01 ACME challenge files. Required only when using nginx-letsencrypt.conf with AppFlowy-Certbot.

ports.name: HTTP Port
ports.description: HTTP port exposed to your Unraid host / LAN. This is the main AppFlowy access port.

ports.name: HTTPS Port
ports.description: HTTPS port. Only needed if you configure TLS in nginx.conf.
